cards.title: Spoonjoy web: current Ouro UI, and the MCP on the AX kit
cards.outcome: Upgrade Ouro HX to the current tag, move the MCP onto the AX kit, and run `ax-xray` on it in CI with `must` claims passing.

issue.title: Adoption: Spoonjoy web: current Ouro UI, and the MCP on the AX kit

cards.title: Spoonjoy Apple: OuroHX components instead of hand-built controls
cards.outcome: Replace hand-built buttons, sheets, toasts and empty states with `OuroHX` components; raise the X-ray score and fix the entity-property failures.

issue.title: Adoption: Spoonjoy Apple: OuroHX components instead of hand-built controls

cards.title: Ouro MD: menus and toolbar through DocumentActions
cards.outcome: Route menu and toolbar commands through `DocumentActions`, move to the current ouro-ui-apple, and raise the X-ray score.

issue.title: Adoption: Ouro MD: menus and toolbar through DocumentActions

cards.title: Gatefold: Ouro HX and Ouro AX
cards.outcome: Gatefold takes Ouro HX tokens and components, adds App Intents with Ouro AX, and goes up from 0 of 30 on the X-ray.

issue.title: Adoption: Gatefold: Ouro HX and Ouro AX

cards.title: ouro CLI on the AX kit
cards.outcome: Run the `ouro` CLI through the AX kit (or a claims-equivalent), run `ax-xray` in CI and publish its score.

issue.title: Adoption: ouro CLI on the AX kit

cards.title: Harness mailbox UI on Ouro HX
cards.outcome: Replace the Catalyst copies in `packages/mailbox-ui` with Ouro HX components and tokens, and add Ouro check to its CI.

issue.title: Adoption: Harness mailbox UI on Ouro HX

cards.title: Desk MCP on the AX kit
cards.outcome: Adopt `defineCommand` and `ax-mcp` for the Desk MCP tools beyond the vendored files, and run the X-ray against the MCP.

issue.title: Adoption: Desk MCP on the AX kit

cards.title: Factory site on Ouro HX
cards.outcome: Move the factory site onto Ouro HX tokens and components and run Ouro check in CI.

issue.title: Adoption: Factory site on Ouro HX

cards.title: Ouro UI's own CLIs on defineCommand
cards.outcome: Build `ouro-check`, `ax-xray`, `ouro-images` and the flows runner with `defineCommand`, so the kit has a production user in its own repository.

issue.title: Adoption: Ouro UI's own CLIs on defineCommand

cards.title: Registry and site agent door
cards.outcome: Give the registry and the site an MCP or WebMCP door.

issue.title: Adoption: Registry and site agent door

cards.title: Go and plain-JS paths to Ouro AX
cards.outcome: Decide how Go (m365crawl, crawlkit) and plain-JS CLIs adopt Ouro AX: a Go port of the kit, or black-box X-ray only.

issue.title: Adoption: Go and plain-JS paths to Ouro AX

cards.title: This ledger
cards.outcome: Publish the adoption table as a living page, with a give-back count per product and a check that flags a consumer whose pinned tag falls behind.

cards.title: Housesitter gives its Reins shape back
cards.outcome: Housesitter gives its `ls`/`do` shape back as a conformance test for the Reins protocol spec, and the X-ray checks it.

issue.title: Adoption: Housesitter gives its Reins shape back

cards.title: ouroboros.bot on current Ouro UI
cards.outcome: Move `OURO_UI_TAG` to current and replace the raw `<button>` and `<input>` elements in 17 files with Ouro components.

issue.title: Adoption: ouroboros.bot on current Ouro UI

cards.title: The Ouro UI rule in every repository's AGENTS.md
cards.outcome: Add the "Interfaces follow Ouro UI" rule to the AGENTS.md of every repository in the ledger that is silent today.

issue.title: Adoption: The Ouro UI rule in every repository's AGENTS.md
